variants.title: C-V of a one-sided p+-n junction: built-in potential
variants.sample: Abrupt p+-n silicon junction, NA 1e19, ND 1e16 per cm^3 (SIMULATED)
variants.unknown: built-in potential, doping of the lightly doped side, profile
variants.note: The depletion layer lies almost all on the lightly doped n side, so 1/C^2 gives ND, and the intercept gives Vbi, which must equal (kT/q) ln(NA ND/ni^2). ni of silicon 1.0e10 per cm^3 at 300 K - from memory - verify.

source.title: Sze and Ng, Physics of Semiconductor Devices, ch. 2

variants.title: C-V of a MOS capacitor: flat-band voltage
variants.sample: Al / 10 nm SiO2 / p-Si MOS capacitor, NA 1e17 per cm^3 (SIMULATED)
variants.method: high-frequency C-V from accumulation to inversion
variants.unknown: oxide capacitance, flat-band voltage, substrate doping
variants.note: Accumulation gives Cox; the depletion branch's 1/C^2 line reaches 1/Cox^2 at the flat-band voltage VFB = phi_ms - Qox/Cox; inversion levels off at Cmin. phi_ms and the oxide charge are illustrative.

source.title: Schroder, Semiconductor Material and Device Characterization, ch. 6
